user.title: Add a PJLink projector
user.description: Search the local network for projectors, or enter an address yourself.

auth.title: Password required
auth.description: The projector at {host} has PJLink authentication switched on.

manual.title: Projector address
manual.description: PJLink must be enabled in the projector's network settings. Leave the password empty if PJLink authentication is off.

data_description.port: PJLink uses TCP port 4352 unless the projector says otherwise.

reauth_confirm.title: Password rejected
reauth_confirm.description: {name} ({host}) no longer accepts the stored PJLink password.

progress.scan: Searching the network for PJLink projectors. This takes a few seconds.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect. Check the address, that the projector has network standby enabled, and that PJLink is switched on.
error.password_required: This projector requires a PJLink password.
error.not_pjlink: Something answered at that address, but it does not speak PJLink.
error.no_devices_found: No new projectors were found. Enter the address manually.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the log for details.

abort.already_configured: This projector is already set up.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to ask the projector for its status. Warm-up and cool-down are always polled every 3 seconds.

send_command.name: Send PJLink command
send_command.description: Sends any PJLink command to the projector and returns its answer.

command.name: Command
command.description: Four-letter PJLink command, for example POWR, INPT, AVMT, LAMP or FREZ.

parameter.name: Parameter
parameter.description: Value to set, or ? to query.

pjlink_class.name: PJLink class
pjlink_class.description: 1 for the original commands, 2 for the Class 2 additions (FREZ, SVOL, IRES...).
